svg.title: Tech constellation: skills and toolkit
svg.desc: Offensive: Metasploit, Burp Suite, SQLMap, Nikto, Gobuster, Hydra. Recon: Nmap, Masscan, Shodan, Maltego. Active Directory: BloodHound, CrackMapExec, Impacket, Mimikatz. Web, API, mobile: OWASP, JWT, MobSF, Frida. Cloud and SIEM: Splunk, Wazuh, Sentinel, QRadar, Sigma, KQL. GRC: ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS.
